client.business_model: Multi-site, physician-led dermatology practice network operating clinics across New England
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 as a solo dermatology practice, APDerm has expanded through acquisitions and de-novo openings to become the largest physician-led dermatology network in New England, offering medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology services across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island.

revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates conflict significantly: Growjo estimates $44.7 M while LeadIQ lists $2.7 M. No audited or company-issued figures located, so revenue is left as null.

locations.source: Company website locations page (https://www.apderm.com) quoted in web search result: 'With over 40 locations across Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island'.
locations.notes: Official site states 'over 40 locations'; exact count not enumerated in documents.

employees.source: Indeed company profile (501-1,000 employees) and LeadIQ (~501 employees); corroborated by SignalHire (500-1,000).
employees.notes: Multiple sources cluster around ~500+ employees, while a few (Growjo 154, BounceWatch 195) report lower numbers likely reflecting partial data. Using 500 as midpoint of higher, repeated range.

extraction_sources: Company website: https://www.apderm.com (locations page, accessed via web search)
BusinessWire press releases on APDerm expansion (cited in web search results)
extraction_notes: Legal name confirmed from signed services agreement (Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC) and Treya case study.
PE ownership: Waud Capital Partners investment confirmed by Mergr and Provident Healthcare Partners web pages referenced in search results.
Revenue figures are estimates from third-party databases with large variance and no primary confirmation; therefore left null with low confidence.
Locations count taken from company’s own wording ('over 40'); no complete list found in documents.
Employee count varies widely across databases; majority of sources that include full-time/part-time counts indicate 500+, so a midpoint of 500 is reported with medium confidence.
